scripts.speaker: Dewata Sailor
scripts.text:
Do you want to visit ^8B4513Dewata Island^000000?
With its dazzling waves and charming vistas it's a great place to relax.
The transit fee is 10,000 Zeny and 1,000 for VIP.

scripts.speaker: Dewata Sailor
scripts.text:
Do you want to visit ^8B4513Dewata Island^000000?
With its dazzling waves and charming vistas it's a great place to relax.
The transit fee is 10,000 Zeny.
Yes!
No.

scripts.speaker: Dewata Sailor
scripts.text:
^8B4513Dewata^000000 is a beautiful and peaceful island country.
Have a nice trip~

scripts.speaker: Dewata Sailor
scripts.text:
You don't have the dough, kid.
Come back when you have a bigger wallet.

scripts.speaker: Dewata Sailor
scripts.text:
Let me know
when you're ready to travel~

scripts.speaker: Alberta Sailor
scripts.text: Do you want to go back to Alberta?
Yes.
No.

scripts.speaker: Alberta Sailor
scripts.text:
I hope you had a lot of fun on
your trip to ^8B4513Dewata^000000 Island.
Please come again!

scripts.speaker: Alberta Sailor
scripts.text:
Have some more fun before you go.
^8B4513Dewata^000000 Island still has more to offer.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: What's wrong with your faaaaaace? You must really be clueless!

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: Let me drop some knowledge on ya.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: I may be a youngling, but no one knows more than I do about ^777700Palm fruit^000000. All right! What do you want to know?
About the shell...
About the pulp...
About the palm kernel...
No thanks.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: So you want to know about Palm fruit's pulp? Let me explain.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: Normally Palm fruit shell is used for making oil. Palm Oil is a useful ingredient for many dishes.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: Hmm... Have you met Memo already? Then it should be easy for you to understand.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: If you want to know how to use Palm Oil, go find Memo on the north side of Dewata island. Everyday, he makes traditional drinks with Palm Oil.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: Anyways, we refer to the oil that comes from the Palm fruit as Palm oil or Coconut oil, which is well known for it's quality.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: The leftovers from oil production gets dried, and used for fuel in cooking or heating.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: It burns well and has a good smell, can't get better than that.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: Ok!! That is all about the pulp, it takes too long to explain all those useful effects for Palm fruit shells.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: It's not like this is the extent of my knowledge. Don't get me wrong!

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: So you want to know about the Palm interior? Let me explain.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: Palm tree fruit has 2 layers of pulp. Outside is very rough, and the inside is smooth...

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: Hmm... Yes! the pulp of Palm tree fruit is a little bit harder than a walnut shell, must be the water it contains inside.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: Inside of the shell, there's about 300cc water which is useful in quenching people's thirst since Dewata island has very hot weather.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: And it's not like we just throw it away once we drink the water inside!!

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: We also can make a quality canteen out of it! Like I said, it has really thick outer shell enough and can act as a water bottle.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: It is also great to make charcoal. Charcoal made out of palm fruit is well known for long lasting and quality fire,

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: People love to cook seafoods and chicken with Palm fruit charcoal..

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: It has the extra bonus of being burning with a pleasant palm smell

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: Ok!! That is all for pulp information, it takes too long to explain all those useful effects.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: It's not like this is all I know. Don't get me wrong!

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: So, you want to know about tender kernel inside? Let me explain for you

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: The kernel inside of the hard pulp is used as a natural digestive.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: Not much to say about the kernel inside..

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: but we do make sure to use every part of the palm fruit.

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: Wouldn't you agree?

scripts.speaker: Fruit Fancier
scripts.text: Arrgg! You have no interest in the world!

scripts.speaker: Lazy Young Man
scripts.text: Why are you carrying so much? Isn't it heavy?

scripts.speaker: Lazy Young Man
scripts.text:
Wewt~!! Isn't that Palm Juice?
Can you give me that? I just woke
up, and my throat is parched!
Give
Do not give

scripts.speaker: Lazy Young Man
scripts.text: Really? For me?? I'll give you this in return... Thanks... Hehe~

scripts.speaker: Lazy Young Man
scripts.text: So be it~ Ok...

scripts.speaker: Lazy Young Man
scripts.text:
Ah~ Thristy~ Anyone have some Palm
juice for me?~

scripts.speaker: Lazy Young Man
scripts.text:
Arrgg~ I'm thirsty~~ so thirsty~~
Give me Palm juice... Palm Juuiice~~

scripts.speaker: Nasolo
scripts.text:
Wow~ Pure ocean, a warm beach...
Perfect for a date with a girlfriend...

scripts.speaker: Nasolo
scripts.text: If only I had one...

scripts.speaker: Nasolo
scripts.text: I wonder when my princess will come...

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: You came to taste my dish? It is always good to eat with an empty stomach.

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text:
Welcome to the island of Dewata.
I hope you behave like a noble
traveler, unlike some of these
teenage punks...
About Dewata dishes
Today's menu?
I'm okay.

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: Need info about our foods? Well... I don't have much to talk about, but feel free to listen if you want.

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: So much to cover, let me begin.

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: First, Dewata dishes have special names based on each cooking recipe,

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: If dish name has 'Goreng' in it, then it is either stir or deep fried food.

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: If it is a type of 'Bakar', then it is a grilled food.

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: And if it's 'Satay', then you are eating a skewered dish.

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: Second, we have dishes named after basic ingredients,

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: In Dewata island, we call rice as Nasi, noodle as Mie, bread as Roti, chicken as Ayam, fish as Ikan, and corn as Jagung.

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: So, if rice is fried we call it 'Nasi Goreng', and fried noodle is 'Mie Goreng'.

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: Well... This is enough to enjoy our foods in Dewata!! If you are hungry, we have our special set menu for only ^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny.

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: We have 2 items 'Nasi Goreng' and 'Satay'. Which one do you want?
Nasi Goreng
Satay

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: This is Nasi Goreng fried with my special sauce plus egg fry on the top. It only costs ^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny.

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: This is the Satay, a slice of meat skewered and grilled over Palm fruit charcoal. It costs only ^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny.
Taste
Walk away

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: Where's the money kid? Sheesh! No free food here! Ok?

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: Here's your {0}, you won't regret it!

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: It's a shame you won't taste this great dish...

scripts.speaker: Restauranteur
scripts.text: Are you serious? This is not even funny.

scripts.speaker: Gourmet
scripts.text:
Oh... it's like a party in my
mouth... and everyone's invited!

scripts.speaker: Gourmet
scripts.text: Master~ One more please~

scripts.speaker: Gourmet
scripts.text: You must try this! The Food here is succulent~

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text:
Wow...
How many has he already eaten?

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text: He must be big eater, not the gourmet...

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text: Have you been to Prontera yet? I think I've seen him somewhere..

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text:
This temple behind me is called Borobudur.
Borobudur temple was built in the 9th century
to venerate the Great Buddha, an ancient religious figure.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: This temple is made with 6 square platforms and 3 round platforms, and 2672 hand carved relief panels as well as 504 statue of various Buddhas.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: The central stupa, or shrine is located at the center of high platform, which is surrounded by 72 more statues.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text: Even in modern times Borobudur temple is a pilgrimage site for many monks worshiping the Buddha. It's also a major tourist attraction, as you can imagine.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text:
That is all I have on Borobudur temple, are there any questions?
If not, we can move to the next spot.

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text:
Oh, dag-nabbit... I've gone and
picked the wrong tour guide...

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text:
This hombre is a real snooze...
Why make it longer..

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text: I need to change my travel agent...

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text:
Hey, let's go there! Hurry up,
while the tour guide is explaining~

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text:
Come on... It doesn't sound like
he's going to stop talking anytime soon.

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text: Aren't we going to get lost without the guide?

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text: We got lost already last time...

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text:
Oh~ This is very interesting. A
temple that worships the Buddha...

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text:
But I don't really get all the
symbology here.

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text:
So beautiful... I wonder who built
this place?

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: I am a monk, content to spend my days in religious study.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: I've just returned from a pilgrimage to Borobudur temple with my fellow monks...

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Borobudur temple has many pilgrims visiting, since it is one of few temples left for worshipping the Great Buddha.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Borobudur temple is one of few temples left for worshiping the Great Buddha.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: I don't understand why there are only few temples left that follow our ways...

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Are you a Tourist? You can make an offering and a wish to one of the shrines.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Our great Buddha may grant your wish..

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Our great Buddha is the king of souls and the leader of all good Gods.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: The Dewata tribes believes in Buddha, the strange thing is they all describe Buddha as different creatures.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: I'm not really sure about the reason for that. Maybe because there are many different tribes in Dewata with different characteristics.
There is a small shrine here. There are many people making wishes.
Make a donation.
Make a wish.
Walk away.

Donation case says:
^FF00001,000 ~ 100,000 Zeny^000000
How much do you want to donate?
- Cancelled. -
- Not enough Zeny. -
What is your wish?
You make a wish for ^0000FF{0}^000000 to the small shrine.
- A celestial entity gives you a blessing. -
- The shrine envelops you in a loving aura. -
It feels like this wish could come true.
What is your wish?
You have made your wish for ^0000FF{0}^000000 to the small shrine.
It feels like this wish could come true.
Mysterious energy comes out from the shrine.
You have received the shrine's blessing.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: You are a stranger here. What brings here to this quiet place?
I'm sightseeing.
No reason.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Oh, you are a tourist. This is the '^0000FFPagoda^000000' worshiping the great Buddha. Please be respectful of the monks praying here.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Good day to you...

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: We have a pagoda for the worship of Buddhas. Each temple has one of these towers, though not many people come here besides other monks.
I see...
Explain about Buddhas
Ah, okay.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: You must feel the compassion of our Buddha!

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Buddha is our God from Dewata myth, he is the king of souls and also the leader of good Gods.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Buddha is the guardian of souls whom often described in traditional dance as fighting against the magician Rangda.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: In Dewata we belive there are many deities protecting each island and tribal locale,

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: so we do have different manifestations of the Buddha, usually described as a bear, tiger, dragon, snake, or lion

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Great Lion is one of famous Buddhas worshipped in Dewata.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Hope this was good explanation for you. Let me know if you have anything else you want to know.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Good day to you...

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: This tower is built on the edge of coastal cliff. You can pray with a cool ocean breeze in your hair.

scripts.speaker: Monk
scripts.text: Come, you should feel the compassion of our Buddha in this pleasant weather.

scripts.speaker: Lodge Owner
scripts.text: These days, we have many honeymooners visiting here.

scripts.speaker: Lodge Owner
scripts.text: It must be the beautiful scenery, right?

scripts.speaker: Lodge Owner
scripts.text: I'm happy with my business. Hope all we have a lot more visitors like that.

scripts.speaker: Lodge Owner
scripts.text:
Ah! You should bring your lover to Dewata on your honeymoon.
I'll give you a good price-

scripts.speaker: Lodge employee
scripts.text: Argg~ This is really ticking me off!

scripts.speaker: Lodge employee
scripts.text: How come more and more couples come here?

scripts.speaker: Lodge employee
scripts.text: And why do they have act so lovey-dovey? What's up with that?

scripts.speaker: Lodge employee
scripts.text: C'mon, show some respect to the people who work here...

scripts.speaker: Sweet Husband
scripts.text: You are the most beautiful thing in the world baby~

scripts.speaker: Sweet Wife
scripts.text: Really? I'm that beautiful? I love you, honey~

scripts.speaker: Sweet Married Couple
scripts.text:
Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha
Hohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohoho
Come on now, I'm growing tired of this. Let's go.

scripts.speaker: Sweet Wife
scripts.text: Baby~ You know what flower that is~?

scripts.speaker: Sweet Husband
scripts.text: Hmm? I don't know. But it's really pretty.

scripts.speaker: Sweet Wife
scripts.text: Baby~ Who's prettier, me or the flower?

scripts.speaker: Sweet Husband
scripts.text: No matter how pretty the flower is, you are always more beautiful~

scripts.speaker: Sweet Wife
scripts.text: Really? I'm that pretty? I love you, sweetie~

scripts.speaker: Sweet Married Couple
scripts.text:
Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha
Hohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohoho
Come on now, this bores me. Let's move on.

scripts.speaker: Reclining Tourist
scripts.text: Wow~ This is really comfy~

scripts.speaker: Reclining Tourist
scripts.text: I'm having a great time just relaxing.

scripts.speaker: Reclining Tourist
scripts.text:
You should lie down here too.
Once you do, you'll never want to get up.

scripts.speaker: Reclining Tourist
scripts.text: That's why I haven't moved in a whole week! Hahahaha~

scripts.speaker: Kid
scripts.text: Hey {0}, look at that man!

scripts.speaker: Kid
scripts.text: He's been lying there for a week doin' nothin'...

scripts.speaker: Kid
scripts.text: Who IS that man?

scripts.speaker: Kid
scripts.text: I don't want to be a lazybones like him when I grow up.

scripts.speaker: Sarr
scripts.text:
They're hiding so I should seek.
I'll find them for sure!-

scripts.speaker: Sarr
scripts.text: One~

scripts.speaker: Sarr
scripts.text: Two~ Three~

scripts.speaker: Sarr
scripts.text: Four~ Five~ Six~

scripts.speaker: Sarr
scripts.text: Ninty nine~ One hundred!!! Now I'm coming~

scripts.speaker: Siyak
scripts.text: Hey come on, move over~ He's gonna find me~~

scripts.speaker: Sarr
scripts.text: I found Siyak!! Come out, come out!!

scripts.speaker: Siyak
scripts.text: Arrgg!! This is all your fault~!!

scripts.speaker: Sipo
scripts.text: Sarr won't find me here, right?

scripts.speaker: Sarr
scripts.text: I found Siyak!! Come out come out!!

scripts.speaker: Sipo
scripts.text: Hehe~ Now Siyak is IT~ I'll just keep hiding in here.

scripts.speaker: Majya
scripts.text: I was playing hide-and-seek with my friends...

scripts.speaker: Majya
scripts.text: I've been just standing here, and they haven't found me for 3 hours...

scripts.speaker: Majya
scripts.text: What should I do? Come out? I don't want to be IT...

scripts.speaker: Ukki
scripts.text: WaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaa~
Hey, kid...

scripts.speaker: Ukki
scripts.text: WaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaa~

scripts.speaker: Ukki
scripts.text: Mama~ Papa~ Where are youuu~ Waa~

scripts.speaker: Mum
scripts.text: Ukki~ Ukki~ Where did she go?

scripts.speaker: Mum
scripts.text: I can't take my eyes of her for a second...

scripts.speaker: Mum
scripts.text: Ukki~

scripts.speaker: Poppa
scripts.text: Honey, is Ukki lost again?

scripts.speaker: Poppa
scripts.text: Arrgg... I can't go anywhere with her... How many times already?

scripts.speaker: Daddy
scripts.text:
She's gotten lost in Luoyang, Amatsu, Moscovia, Brasilis, Kunlun,
and in Ayothaya...

scripts.speaker: Daddy
scripts.text: What!! It's already been 7 times including this time in Dewata... 7 times!!!!!!

scripts.speaker: Happily Married Grandpa
scripts.text:
Today, I should ask my lady to
cook me some ^006400fried rice^000000.

scripts.speaker: Happily Married Grandpa
scripts.text:
My wife's ^006400fried rice^000000 is
always very special!

scripts.speaker: Happily Married Grandpa
scripts.text:
It makes me love her even more.
You can't imagine the wonderful flavor!

scripts.speaker: Happily Married Grandma
scripts.text:
In my younger days,
there were many gentleman callers
who wanted to court me.

scripts.speaker: Happily Married Grandma
scripts.text:
Yet, I met just the right guy,
and got married.
I asked what he likes best
about me, he said it was
my homemade ^006400fried rice^000000

scripts.speaker: Happily Married Grandma
scripts.text:
And since then, he only asks me
to make ^006400fried rice^000000 for dinner.
Over 40 years of marriage
and he still doesn't get tired ot it.

scripts.speaker: Happily Married Grandma
scripts.text:
I always think it was lucky
to be growing old with a guy
who loves what I cook.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Semangat
scripts.text:
I also traveled around the World
When I was young like you.
^FF0000Monkey, Cuttlefish^000000
^FF0000Eagle, and Snake^000000,
all were good friends I met
during my travels.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Semangat
scripts.text:
I still have passion for adventure and traveling.
But, I can't just leave
my beloved wife and
grandchildren behind...

scripts.speaker: Adventurer Semangat
scripts.text:
You will also have something
or someone that is as precious
in your heart someday.

scripts.speaker: Semangat's Wife
scripts.text:
Where's that old man
gone off to again?
Have you seen my husband around?
I think I saw him there..
No I haven't..

scripts.speaker: Semangat's Wife
scripts.text:
He ran away when
I was looking for him.
Should be somewhere, telling tall tales
to some travelers, like always.

scripts.speaker: Semangat's Wife
scripts.text:
I apologize
on behalf of my husband.
Please don't believe his foolish stories
saying he met with ^FF0000Monkeys and Snakes^000000, or
that he fought alongside a ^FF0000Cuttlefish^000000.

scripts.speaker: Semangat's Wife
scripts.text:
He has been living here
for entire life.
Yet, always find some travelers,
and who will listen to his made-up tales.

scripts.speaker: Semangat's Wife
scripts.text:
Oh. Please let me know
if you ever see him around.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
Isn't ^8B4513Dewata^000000 beach
really beautiful?
The children always play
at this beach. It really
reminds me of my youth.

scripts.speaker: Young Man
scripts.text:
At the evening, you can see
fireworks from the beach.
With ocean breeze, the crashing waves,
and fireworks lighting the sky,
the nighttime is a time of beauty here!

scripts.speaker: Young Lady
scripts.text:
When you are outside of the town,
and meet ^FF0000Tiger, Monkey, or pig^000000,
make sure to avoid them.
What do you mean?

scripts.speaker: Young Lady
scripts.text:
I haven't seen yet,
but legend says there's a
cruel monster named ^FF0000Leak^000000
which can transform into an animal
and hypnotize people into killing.

scripts.speaker: Young Lady
scripts.text:
You know the dangers of this world.
It's never hurts to be careful
even if it's just an urban legend.

scripts.speaker: Settler
scripts.text:
I'm not really from ^8B4513Dewata^000000.
But while traveling,
I found this place...
And made my decision
to live in this beautiful town.

scripts.speaker: Settler
scripts.text:
I've been happy to live here
and to find and experience
all these beautiful sights.
It's a dream come true.

scripts.speaker: Settler
scripts.text:
Would you ever think of
settling here too?

scripts.speaker: Dieting Lady
scripts.text:
Ah~ I'm starving!!
I should be on a diet now.
Why am I still hungry?

scripts.speaker: Dieting Lady
scripts.text:
Don't talk to me too much!!
I want to try that grilled ^006400Satay^000000
so much~!!!!!

scripts.speaker: Dieting Lady
scripts.text:
Is that mouth-watering
^006400Satay^000000 for me?
Yes, want a taste?
No, it's for me!

scripts.speaker: Dieting Lady
scripts.text:
Thanks so much!
I've been so hungry~!!
This smell of this ^006400Satay^000000
is so good~!

scripts.speaker: Dieting Lady
scripts.text:
Ah... gotta come back to my senses,
too much of a good thing is bad...
I should stick with my diet.
Sorry, I'll give it back to you.

scripts.speaker: Dieting Lady
scripts.text:
Arrgg.. You are so greedy!
Since you don't want to share.
Anyway, I shouldn't cheat on my diet
even for something that looks and smells so good...

scripts.speaker: Dreaming Kid
scripts.text:
My granny says
There was once a bird named ^FF0000Garuda^000000
who flew above this town.
Afterwards we had some great harvests
and were able to live happily.

scripts.speaker: Dreaming Kid
scripts.text:
I want to see that bird
flying above our town again!
Then my mom, dad
granny, and grandpa
can be happy like the old times.
What do you think?

scripts.speaker: Energetic Kid
scripts.text: My parents used to tell me...

- ^006400Son,^000000 -
- ^006400You should study hard.^000000 -
- ^006400Be happy.^000000 -
- ^006400Live a slow^000000 -
- ^006400and safe life.^000000 -
- ^006400The mountain over yonder^000000 -
- ^006400will always be there for you.^000000 -

scripts.speaker: Energetic Kid
scripts.text:
Isn't it a great philosophy?
I want to live that way
and become a great person,
and help all of the people in our town
live happily ever after!

scripts.speaker: Kid wishing to be an adult
scripts.text:
My family has been brewing
traditional Dewata wine for ages.
I want to drink it myself,
but my dad says I'm too young.
He said I can drink it
only after I sleep for over ^FF0000100 days^000000.

scripts.speaker: Kid wishing to be an adult
scripts.text:
All grown-ups love to drink
my dad's wine.
I want to try some so bad.
But, what should I do...?
I've forgotten how many ^FF0000nights^000000
I've already slept... boo hoo!

scripts.speaker: Jaty Tribe Gatekeeper
scripts.text:
Welcome to ^FF0000Jaty^000000 town.
Our tribe reveres strength and bravery.
We wish you a safe and restful time here.

scripts.speaker: Reserved Jaty Warrior
scripts.text:
I want to be the very best
like no one ever was.

scripts.speaker: Reserved Jaty Warrior
scripts.text:
I'm learning hunting skills
these days. And I'm getting
better and better
every day!

scripts.speaker: Reserved Jaty Warrior
scripts.text:
I won't stop until
I become a true warrior!
